title: WHAT IF A STAR 350X THE SUN SWALLOWED YOU?

segments.line: You are a small star. A giant star is swallowing you.
It is three hundred fifty times wider than the Sun.
Its surface would reach past Mars.
You touch it, and the plunge begins.
It takes just seven laps, about seven years.
Other mergers took thousands of laps.
Then, on seventeen October twenty twenty-five, it erupts.
A hundred times brighter in under a month.
Webb caught the aftermath, forty-seven days later.
The small star did not escape. It was dragged to the core.
Astronomers watched a stellar merger from start to finish. A first.
Full film on the channel. Tomorrow: what if the Moon vanished?
